about_the_game:
Dark December unfolds in the prequel universe of Undecember, set in a turbulent era where remnants of ancient civilizations clash with mythic powers.

As the player, you will uncover the forgotten truth of a fallen hero, confronting powerful factions across a battlefield consumed by chaos.

Experience an epic tale where myth and destiny intertwine brought to life through immersive storytelling and intense action.

Welcome to the world of DarkDecember

Master strategic party-based raids, harness class-specific rune systems, and customize your gear through the power of Aether Cores — all to forge a character stronger than ever before.

In DarkDecember, weapons are more than just steel.

They evolve with your will, becoming a force capable of reshaping the battlefield itself.

Immersive Campaign and Growth

Strengthen your character through strategic party-based raids, class-specific rune systems, and item customization powered by Aether Cores.

In DarkDecember, weapons are more than mere steel they evolve with the player’s will, becoming a force capable of reshaping the tide of battle.

Endless Challenges

Test your limits in the Corridor of Oblivion and the Dimensional Rift.
The Corridor of Oblivion is a place where forgotten memories and present nightmares collide where fallen bosses rise once more, stronger than ever, to challenge you again.

In the Dimensional Rift, you must join forces with your allies to fend off waves of enemies seeking to resurrect the sealed Valknut.
Stand your ground against the oncoming darkness and protect a crumbling world.
The hero who can turn the tide of fate is you.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains content that may not be appropriate for all ages or for viewing at work: frequent violence, blood, and sexually suggestive content.
Revealing costumes and swimsuits are included in the game, and combat scenes may feature violent imagery and blood splatter effects.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4430 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 2GB or AMD Radeon R7 370 2GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600k or AMD Ryzen5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
